subject: Group technical walkthrough — updated bridge & attendee roll-call
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acme-analytics.com>, Susan Lee <susan@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Group technical walkthrough — proposed times + bridge

Hi Alex and Susan,

Thanks for agreeing to join a joint technical walkthrough next week — the aim is a 45-minute demo focused on inference performance tuning and quick wins for cost/latency tradeoffs. We have a couple of customers with overlapping interests and thought this format would be efficient.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 6/22 — 10:00–10:45
- Wed 6/23 — 14:00–14:45

We can do Zoom or a Redwood-hosted bridge. Quick ask: which slot works and whether you prefer a standard Zoom link or our managed bridge (allows easy recording + auto captions).

Draft agenda: 1) 10 min architecture + telemetry, 2) 20 min demo (live model run + perf knobs), 3) 10 min Q&A / next steps.

Ben will run the demo and Monica will handle any procurement/contract questions that come up.

Attachments: attendee_rollcall.csv (blank schedule you can fill), test_payload.json (example request) — please review.

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: Group technical walkthrough — proposed times + bridge

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the invite. Wed 6/23 14:00 PT would be ideal for our team (gives us time to prep). One note: we have a vendor review at 14:15 that day — can we aim for 13:30–14:15 instead? That would let us join the full session.

Also — we prefer standard Zoom (company policy). If you must use Redwood bridge, please confirm it supports our SSO domain (acme-analytics.com).

I filled in a couple of attendees on the attached rollcall (first pass).

Best,
Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Analytics

Subject: Re: Group technical walkthrough — bridge notes + attendee sync

Vanessa / Ben —

Quick notes after reading Alex's reply:
- Redwood managed bridge supports SSO for enterprise orgs, but we need a one-time allowlist step from Acme's IdP admin. If they can't do that quickly, we should use Zoom.
- Zoom is fine but we lose automatic capture of token-level logs (we can always upload the recording to Drive post-demo).
- If we move to 13:30–14:15 PT on 6/23 that overlaps Ben's 12:30 prep; Ben, can you shift your run-through to 11:30–12:15? If not, we should keep 14:00–14:45 and ask Alex to join until 14:15 only.

I've attached a one-page bridge_instructions.pdf with steps for SSO allowlist and a quick 'how to join' for external guests. Also exported the attendee_rollcall.csv with names Ben requested.

Proposed fallback plan (if Acme can't allowlist): host on Zoom + host recording to Drive + share perf artifacts after.

M

monica.patel@redwood.ai

Hi Alex / Susan —

Thanks for the quick replies. Final plan below:

- Time: Wed, 2027-06-23 13:30–14:15 PT (shortened to 45 mins to accommodate your calendar)
- Bridge: Zoom (per Acme request; Monica will upload recording to Drive and share notes)
- Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (calendar invite updated)
- Agenda: 10m architecture + telemetry; 20m live demo; 10m Q&A; 5m next steps

Alex — I noted your team will need to drop at 14:15 for a vendor review; we'll prioritize your questions during the 10m Q&A and can follow up with a 15-min deep-dive if needed.

Ben — please run the demo and include the latency breakdown slide (slide 6 in the shared deck). Monica — can you confirm you uploaded bridge_instructions.pdf and the attendee CSV to Drive and update the calendar invite?

- Acme: Alex Johnson, Priya Rao (data platform)
